headline: Southside Savages: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Southside Savages is projected #7 of 16 with a 626.40 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Drake Maye, Josh Jacobs, and Tetairoa McMillan. The immediate priority is improving the TE slot without weakening that core. On the Power Rankings webpage's D-AVI ladder, the franchise ranks #7 of 16 with a 187.0 team D-AVI score.
